query.sparql:
PREFIX dblp: <https://dblp.org/rdf/schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?topic ?venue ?publication ?title ?year ?doi WHERE {
  VALUES (?topic ?group1 ?group2 ?group3) {
    ("secondary-study-method" "systematic literature review|systematic mapping study|multivocal literature review|grey literature" "software engineering" "")
    ("evaluation-validity" "coding agent|program repair|code generation" "benchmark|evaluation|contamination|oracle" "")
    ("grader-validity" "automated evaluation|human evaluation|inter-rater agreement" "software|code" "")
    ("human-review" "code review|pull request review" "artificial intelligence|automation|human" "")
    ("operations-recovery" "agent|automation" "fault injection|recovery|reliability|idempotent" "")
    ("retrieval-context" "code search|repository retrieval|issue localization" "context|developer" "")
    ("topology" "multi-agent|multi agent" "software engineering|programming" "coordination|delegation")
    ("adoption-governance" "generative AI|artificial intelligence" "software engineering|programming" "adoption|governance|accountability")
  }
  VALUES (?venue ?stream) {
    ("tse" <https://dblp.org/streams/journals/tse>)
    ("tosem" <https://dblp.org/streams/journals/tosem>)
    ("emse" <https://dblp.org/streams/journals/ese>)
    ("icse" <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/icse>)
    ("fse" <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/sigsoft>)
    ("ase" <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/kbse>)
    ("issta" <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/issta>)
    ("cscw" <https://dblp.org/streams/conf/cscw>)
  }
  ?publication dblp:publishedInStream ?stream ;
               dblp:title ?title ;
               dblp:yearOfPublication ?year .
  OPTIONAL { ?publication dblp:doi ?doi }
  FILTER (?year >= "2018"^^xsd:gYear && ?year <= "2026"^^xsd:gYear)
    FILTER (?group1 = "" || regex(str(?title), ?group1, "i"))
    FILTER (?group2 = "" || regex(str(?title), ?group2, "i"))
    FILTER (?group3 = "" || regex(str(?title), ?group3, "i"))
}
ORDER BY ?topic ?venue ?year ?publication

interpretation: This credential-free DBLP lane is a title-only census over named venue streams. It broadens and audits venue coverage, but it is not a publisher-native ACM or IEEE search, is not equivalent to Scopus title/abstract/keyword retrieval, and does not establish exhaustive recall. Zero-match cells are preserved rather than silently omitted.
